name: houdini_render
description: Render a ROP (Karma, OpenGL, USD Render, Mantra, a geometry or USD export...) or cook a TOP node or TOP network (PDG) in a separate background hython: the open Houdini stays usable and its file keeps its name. It reads a working copy of the open scene (default) or the file as saved. A ROP renders its frames to its own output, or to the EXACT output you name (shots/shot_####.png gives shot_0001.png...; $F4 also works), with size [w, h] for this render only. Returns a task: call again with task (and wait_s) for progress, or cancel. Relative paths are next to the .hip. An Apprentice license writes images of at most 1920x1080 with the Houdini logo; the result says the size written.

top.description: A TOP node path, or a TOP network (its display node is cooked).

output.description: ROP only: the exact output path; several frames need a # run or $F4.

frames.description: ROP only: a frame, [start, end] or [start, end, step] (default: the ROP's own range).

size.description: ROP only: [width, height], 4 to 16384 (Karma, OpenGL, USD Render, Mantra).

task.description: A task from an earlier call: its progress.

wait_s.description: With task: wait up to this long for it to finish (0 to 3600).
